jobs.title: Senior Manager of Go-to-Market Engineering & Operations
jobs.description:
Allego is a rapidly growing SaaS technology company in the Boston area and creator of the market-leading Revenue Enablement Platform. Our technology helps Go-To-Market teams build the skills and access the knowledge they need to succeed in every selling situation.

Allego is the only revenue enablement platform to be named a Leader in both the Forrester Wave™ and the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Revenue Enablement Platforms.

Not only are we growing quickly, but we've also been recognized as a top place to work by The Boston Business Journal, The Boston Globe, and Inc. Magazine. In addition, Selling Power named Allego one of the 50 Best Companies to Sell For in both 2025 and 2026.

About the Role:

We're building a modern, scalable go-to-market engine, and this role will be instrumental in shaping how we generate pipeline, accelerate revenue, and operate at scale.

As our GTM Operations leader, you will own the systems, processes, data, and automation that power our revenue engine. You will partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, SDR, and Sales teams to ensure our GTM motion is efficient, measurable, and built for growth.

This is not a traditional marketing operations role focused solely on campaign execution or platform administration. We're looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, operational excellence, systems expertise, and AI-driven innovation to create a world-class revenue engine.

You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building scalable processes from the ground up, and are energized by using technology and automation to solve complex business challenges.

Core Responsibilities

GTM Systems & Infrastructure

Own HubSpot as the primary marketing platform, including architecture, workflows, integrations, lifecycle management, and data governance
Partner closely with RevOps and Salesforce teams to ensure seamless data flow and alignment across the revenue funnel
Establish scalable standards for campaign setup, data structure, naming conventions, lifecycle stages, and operational governance
Drive ongoing optimization of the GTM technology stack to improve efficiency, visibility, and performance
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and accessibility of marketing and funnel data

Demand Generation Operations

Own the operational framework supporting demand generation programs from lead capture through qualification, routing, nurture, and handoff
Optimize forms, landing pages, conversion paths, enrichment processes, and routing logic to maximize conversion and data quality
Build and scale email and nurture infrastructure that supports personalized, journey-based engagement
Develop repeatable QA processes, documentation, and governance standards that enable flawless campaign execution
Establish clear intake, prioritization, and project management processes for marketing operations initiatives

Lead Management & Funnel Optimization

Design and evolve a sophisticated lead management framework that combines:
ICP fit and account qualification
Firmographic and technographic data
Behavioral engagement signals
Third-party intent data

Own lead routing, assignment logic, and SLA management across the funnel
Continuously refine scoring and qualification models based on conversion, pipeline, and revenue outcomes
Identify bottlenecks, friction points, and revenue leakage opportunities and implement solutions to improve funnel performance
Partner with SDR and Sales leaders to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline creation

SDR & Inbound Revenue Operations

Own the operational infrastructure supporting inbound lead management and SDR workflows
Create feedback loops between Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams to continuously improve lead quality and conversion performance
Monitor and optimize key metrics including speed-to-lead, contact rates, qualification rates, and pipeline generation
Leverage automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, responsiveness, and revenue outcomes
Ensure alignment across teams through shared processes, reporting, and accountability

Reporting, Attribution & Revenue Insights

Partner with RevOps to develop and evolve attribution models that accurately measure marketing impact
Build and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline creation, funnel health, campaign performance, and revenue contribution
Monitor lifecycle conversion rates and proactively identify trends, risks, and optimization opportunities
Deliver actionable insights that help leadership make informed investment and growth decisions
Establish a culture of data-driven decision making across the GTM organization

Process Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership

Define and maintain operational frameworks, governance standards, SLAs, and prioritization processes
Lead regular reviews of funnel performance, operational effectiveness, and strategic initiatives
Serve as a trusted partner to Marketing, Sales, SDR, and RevOps leaders
Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable processes, systems, and solutions
Drive alignment across teams to ensure a consistent and efficient customer journey

AI & Automation Strategy

Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes
Implement AI-driven workflows that enhance data quality, campaign execution, lead management, reporting, and team productivity
Evaluate emerging technologies and scale successful use cases across the GTM organization
Introduce intelligent automation and prompt-driven workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate execution
Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap for AI adoption within GTM Operations

Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

10+ years in marketing operations, with a track record that spans multiple stages of company growth. Has owned the full ops function — not just administered tools — at a B2B SaaS company. Has built or inherited a broken stack and made it work. Understands what $50M ARR looks like operationally and what $100M needs to look like.

Skills & Qualifications

Deep HubSpot expertise as primary admin — architecture, workflows, lifecycle management, and integration design
Strong Salesforce fluency — can work directly with RevOps or serve as a de facto admin; understands the Marketing↔CRM data layer
Has built multi-touch attribution models and MQL scoring frameworks from scratch, and iterated on them using real conversion data; experience incorporating ICP fit and intent signals (G2, Bombora, 6sense, or equivalent) into lead scoring models
Experienced with AI-powered sales engagement platforms — Nooks AI or comparable inbound SDR tools; understands how inbound lead routing logic works and how to build the feedback loop between Marketing and SDR
Comfortable with BI and reporting tools — can build executive-facing dashboards, not just pull data
Genuine curiosity and working knowledge of AI tools and automation — actively explores how AI can accelerate ops workflows, reduce manual work, and improve data quality; not waiting to be told what to adopt
Visionary orientation — can see where the function needs to be in 18 months and reverse-engineer the roadmap to get there
Has navigated cross-functional ownership disputes between Marketing, RevOps, and Sales Ops; knows how to establish and hold a RACI

Culture and values:

Our core values, better known as Allego's Operating Principles, are at the heart of our business. They are the fabric of our culture and central to our approach to work, our customers and with each other. Take a look here!

Benefits

Allego offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits program that enables employees to choose the benefits that best fit their needs and the needs of their families. Full time new hires are eligible for most benefits on the first day of employment:

Medical/dental/vision
Unlimited vacation
Paid parental leave
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
401(k) with matching
Short & long term disability, AD&D, life insurance

Compensation:
$135,000 - $160,000 base + 10% variable bonus target + equity

jobs.title: Group Senior Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Position is open for Singapore, Johor Bahru and Kuala Lumpur

The Group Infrastructure Manager is accountable for the strategy, governance, and overall performance of the Group’s IT infrastructure environment, spanning networks, servers, cloud platforms, end-user computing, workplace collaboration, and infrastructure security. Reporting to the IDT Director, the Manager owns the Group’s infrastructure and cloud roadmap, the infrastructure budget, and the vendor and service-provider portfolio, and is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness of infrastructure services across all Group sites. The incumbent leads and develops a team of infrastructure and site-reliability professionals, sets technical direction, standards, and policies, drives cloud adoption and automation, and represents infrastructure to senior management and regional stakeholders — ensuring infrastructure capabilities are aligned with, and enable, the Group’s digital transformation agenda.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategic Planning and Predictive Readiness

Develop, own, and govern the Group’s infrastructure and cloud roadmap, ensuring network, cloud, collaboration, and security investments are aligned with business priorities and the Group’s digital strategy.
Define infrastructure standards, architecture principles, and policies, and ensure consistent adoption across all Group sites.
Lead capacity planning, technology refresh, and lifecycle management to anticipate future business requirements, mitigate operational risk, and prevent technology obsolescence.
Own the annual infrastructure budget, including capital and operating expenditure — securing funding, controlling spend, and ensuring value for money.
Establish, govern, and periodically review IT disaster-recovery and business-continuity plans for critical infrastructure services.
Evaluate emerging technologies — cloud services, AIOps, automation, workplace collaboration, and cybersecurity and make investment recommendations where they deliver measurable business value.

Operational and Service Accountability

Hold overall accountability for the availability, performance, security, and cost-efficiency of all infrastructure services against agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Govern incident, problem, and change management, ensuring major incidents are resolved, root causes addressed, and service stability maintained.
Provide governance and assurance over infrastructure projects, ensuring delivery within approved scope, timeline, budget, and quality.
Direct the management and optimisation of the Group’s cloud platforms to enhance scalability, security, resilience, performance, and cost efficiency.
Ensure AIOps, observability, and site-reliability capabilities are developed and matured to drive proactive, resilient operations.
Ensure infrastructure security, patch management, backup operations, and compliance activities are executed in accordance with Group IT policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

People, Vendor and Commercial Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop the infrastructure and site-reliability team — setting objectives, managing performance, and building capability and succession.
Own vendor and service-provider relationships and contracts, including selection, negotiation, commercial management, and SLA governance to secure quality, accountability, and value-for-money outcomes.
Represent infrastructure to the IDT Director, senior management, and regional stakeholders, providing assurance, insight, and recommendations.

Reporting and Insight

Oversee monitoring and reporting of infrastructure availability, performance, capacity, utilisation, risk, and service levels against agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Translate operational and performance trends into management insight and decisions on capacity planning, cost optimisation, service improvement, and risk mitigation.
Ensure accurate asset records, configuration information, infrastructure documentation, and operational procedures are maintained by the team.

EXPERIENCE:
Minimum experience in IT infrastructure of 12 years in a managerial role with accountability for teams, budgets, and vendor contracts.
Proven track record owning and governing infrastructure and cloud strategy, roadmaps, and standards across multiple sites or countries.
Strong experience managing infrastructure budgets (capital and operating), vendor selection, contract negotiation, and commercial governance.
Experience leading cloud adoption and transformation across platforms (e.g. Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Microsoft 365) and hybrid environments.
Experience embedding AIOps, observability, or site-reliability engineering (SRE) and ITIL service management at an organisational level.
Solid grounding in infrastructure security, backup and disaster recovery, IT governance, and regulatory compliance.
Broad experience administering or governing workplace-collaboration platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365, Teams, or Google Workspace). Experience leading multi-site or regional operations, ideally within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Lindcove Ranch is an education management company headquartered in Exeter, California, serving learners and institutions across the United States. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality educational programs and operational support that help clients improve outcomes and efficiency. Lindcove Ranch values innovation, practical solutions, and strong partnerships with the communities it serves. Team members collaborate remotely while supporting a mission-driven environment that emphasizes continuous improvement and learner success.
Role Description
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a full-time remote role responsible for setting and executing the overall technology vision and strategy for Lindcove Ranch. This role oversees software and product development initiatives, ensuring that technology solutions support educational management operations and long-term business goals. The CTO leads architecture decisions, manages IT projects and roadmaps, and coordinates cross-functional collaboration with executive leadership, operations, and educational program teams. Day-to-day tasks include guiding engineering teams, evaluating and selecting platforms and tools, implementing security and compliance standards, and optimizing systems for scalability, reliability, and performance. The CTO also monitors industry trends, manages technology budgets, and mentors team members to support a high-performing, inclusive technology organization.
Qualifications

Strong background in Software Development and Product Development, with experience delivering scalable, user-centered solutions.
Proficiency in IT Strategy and Architecture, including defining technology roadmaps and designing robust, secure systems.
Demonstrated Project Management skills, with a track record of leading complex initiatives from concept to deployment.
Experience in technology leadership roles, preferably in education, edtech, or related service-driven industries.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity best practices, data management, and integration of third-party platforms.
Ability to lead distributed teams, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and make data-informed decisions.
Commitment to inclusive leadership, continuous learning, and fostering an equitable, collaborative work environment.
